Xbox Hub private-source build validation trigger
Request: validate production public-key provisioning and encrypted artifact handoff
Source version: 0.1.7-preview.1
Source commit: cdc9f8801a773f217ee25e6db26ab226745982b5
Scope: Windows x64 restore, app/updater publish, exact two-file ZIP validation, versioned ZIP copy plus SHA-256 equality check, offline signer positive/negative tests with ephemeral CI-only key, production owner RSA package-encryption public-key validation, encrypted package round trip and tamper rejection, ciphertext-only artifact upload, and updater transaction tests.
Security: production private keys and passphrases remain offline on the owner's phone; CI uses only throwaway test signing keys and the configured public encryption key. No plaintext package, private source archive, production private key, TLS key, Cloudflare token, or credential is uploaded.
Final check: confirm package key ID/fingerprint match, ciphertext-only artifact upload succeeds, and all regression tests pass.
